note: Seed file consumed by scripts/build-asset-registry.mjs. Pins per-asset display names, capability flags (V2 preferred; allocationsV1 for the transitional V1 lane), and per-asset overrides (admin party, Scan URL, wallet-gateway URL, token-standard API URL). When SV status / asset-admin metadata is not fully programmatically accessible, populate TBD fields manually after reviewing the public SV network status listing (https://canton.foundation/sv-network-status-2/).

meta.note: Test asset for V2-DevNet probes. Not for Mainnet.

Live on MainNet on the V1 token standard today. Per CIP-0112 §5 Amulet is expected to publish V2 interfaces; once supportedApis advertises V2, flip allocationsV2/transferEventsV2 here — no code change.
meta.adminResolution: The instrument admin is the network's DSO party (network-specific). Resolve at runtime: GET {scanEndpointUrl}/api/scan/v0/dso → dso_party_id; copy into instrumentIdV2.admin and adminParty.
meta.tokenStandardApiNote: Amulet's token-standard registry API is served by Scan at the bare host — choice-context endpoints live under /registry/allocations/v1/..., NOT under /api/scan.
meta.scanUrls: TestNet reference encoded above; MainNet equivalent: https://scan.sv-1.global.canton.network.sync.global
meta.walletGatewayResolution: Deployment-specific — each operator runs their own wallet gateway. Point walletGatewayUrl at your operator's gateway.

meta.note: Live on MainNet on the V1 token standard today. Per CIP-0112 §5 USDCx is expected to publish V2 interfaces; once supportedApis advertises V2, flip allocationsV2/transferEventsV2 here — no code change.
meta.adminResolution: The issuer admin party is deployment-specific. Resolve from the issuer's published token-standard metadata or the public SV network status listing (https://canton.foundation/sv-network-status-2/); copy into instrumentIdV2.admin and adminParty.
meta.tokenStandardApiResolution: USDCx runs a dedicated registry endpoint (not Scan). Resolve the base URL from the issuer's published metadata; choice-context endpoints live under /registry/allocations/v1/... on that base.
meta.scanUrls: TestNet SV Scan reference encoded above (transaction history is network-wide); MainNet equivalent: https://scan.sv-1.global.canton.network.sync.global
meta.walletGatewayResolution: Deployment-specific — each operator runs their own wallet gateway. Point walletGatewayUrl at your operator's gateway.
